annotations.title: List upcoming sessions and free slots at a venue

description: List a venue's upcoming sessions, each with its slots and how many seats are left in each. A slot with seats_left 0 is full. Times are local to the venue.

from_date.description: Optional. Earliest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD, venue local time.

to_date.description: Optional. Latest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD, venue local time.

name: list_sessions
